description: LAYOUT TEMPLATE (static: no sweep). Study room seen from above: place a desk (rectangle D, da) and an armchair (circle S). Both stay whole inside the room and clear of the column; the desk is near the window and faces it within 5 deg; make the walkway between the chair and the desk as wide as possible. Solved with the default 64 starts: feasible, 61 of 65 runs at the optimum walkway = 206.5605 cm, D = (1.165005, 2.6) m, da = 0 deg, S = (3.55, 0.45) m; active: desk_in_2, desk_in_3, chair_in, desk_view.

how_to_edit.params: Every size and limit, by name. A string may carry a unit ("5cm", "10deg"); a JSON number is SI (m, rad).
how_to_edit.params.gap: smallest distance to the walls and to the column
how_to_edit.params.desk_w: desk size along its own x axis (fixed size, so a param)
how_to_edit.params.desk_d: desk depth, along its own y axis
how_to_edit.params.window_max: bound of criterion to_window; change with --bound to_window=100 (cm)
how_to_edit.params.view_tol: bound of criterion desk_view; change with --bound desk_view=10 (deg)
how_to_edit.let.desk: the desk shape: centre D, size desk_w x desk_d, angle da (radians)
how_to_edit.let.facing: unit direction the person at the desk looks at: the desk's +y axis
how_to_edit.let.chair: the armchair shape: circle of centre S
how_to_edit.constraints: desk_in_0..3: one row per desk corner (a convex body is inside a convex room when all its corners are). NEVER write clearance(desk, room) <= -gap: it accepts a desk crossing a wall
how_to_edit.display: GUI drawing only; no effect on the solve
how_to_edit.delete: this how_to_edit object is ignored by geomsolver; delete it when you are done

room.note: EDIT: room outline; closed = it has an inside; keep it convex (split a non-convex room into convex parts)

window.note: EDIT: middle of the window, on the top wall

D.note: EDIT: desk centre; the domain holds this point only, the corners need the desk_in rows

da.note: EDIT: desk angle; keep the range under one turn, ends where the design is worst; value in radians

S.note: EDIT: armchair centre; domain = the reading corner where it may go

constraints.name: desk_in_0
constraints.note: corner 0 of the desk at least gap inside the room

constraints.name: chair_in
constraints.note: a circle is inside when its centre is at least r + gap inside

constraints.name: desk_column
constraints.note: EDIT: no overlap with an obstacle; one row per pair

criteria.name: to_window
criteria.note: EDIT: a wish turned into a bound: desk centre within window_max of the window

criteria.name: desk_view
criteria.note: EDIT: view direction bound: the desk faces the window within view_tol (abs at the top is split into 2 smooth rows)
